# Pre-market brief, Thu Oct 15, 2026 (Research Inc., ~8:32 AM ET)

**Tone: HOT PPI shock (+1.3% vs +0.6% est) on top of hot CPI; AI rout deepening; hike risk up into 10/28 FOMC. Defensives only.**

1. **PPI blowout, 8:30 ET (Sep):** Headline +1.3% MoM (est. +0.6%), 6.3% YoY (est. 5.4%); core +0.7% (est. +0.3%), 5.0% YoY. Retail sales +0.8% (est. +0.3%); claims 199K (in line). Squawk prints; BLS page not yet indexed. ([FinancialJuice](https://x.com/financialjuice/status/2110709977841279364), [FirstSquawk](https://x.com/FirstSquawk/status/2110710013056733363), [Retail](https://x.com/FirstSquawk/status/2110709986548744401))
2. **AI debt rout, day 2 (pre-print):** ~8:00 ET S&P fut −0.2%, Nasdaq-100 −1.1%, Dow +0.3%. CRWV −6% pre after −15% Wed; ORCL −2% after ~−9%; their bond yields at records. Oct hike odds were ~27% pre-PPI. ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/14/stock-market-today-live-updates.html), [Reuters/Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/nasdaq-futures-dive-1-ai-082517898.html))
3. **TSM beat, stock down:** Q3 rev $46.72B (above $44.6–45.8B guide), GM 66.4%; Q4 guide $52.3–54.3B; FY26 growth raised to ~44%. ADR ~−2.7% pre (box yfinance). ([TSMC](https://pr.tsmc.com/english/news/3346), [TSMC IR](https://investor.tsmc.com/english/quarterly-results/2026/q3))
4. **Movers:** WMT ~+3% on Deutsche Bank upgrade to Buy, PT $136. ERIC ~+11% on Q3. SCHW ~−3% (EPS beat, rev miss). AI optics LITE/COHR/CIEN/AAOI −4–5% pre. ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/15/walmart-deutsche-bank-upgrade.html), [Benzinga](https://www.benzinga.com/news/26/10/62374922/why-ericsson-shares-are-trading-higher-by-around-11-here-are-20-stocks-moving-premarket), [Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/earnings/charles-schwab-earnings-beat-by-003-revenue-fell-short-of-estimates-4951393))
5. **Oil / rates / BTC:** Brent ~$104–105, WTI ~$94–95; 10y ~5.19% (from 5.22%); BTC ~$80.9k; VIX ~17.5 (box yfinance ~8:18 ET). ([TipRanks](https://www.tipranks.com/news/stock-market-today-oct-15-futures-mixed-as-tech-stocks-slide-investors-await-ppi-data))

**Today/week:** Fed Bowman, Hammack speak today ([Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/us-stock-market-today-p-081203137.html)). Fri 10/16: import prices 8:30, industrial production 9:15, monthly opex ([Macro Bullseye](https://macrobullseye.com/calendar/2026/10/16/)). FOMC 10/28. Earnings: NFLX 10/20 AMC ([NFLX IR](https://ir.netflix.net/investor-news-and-events/financial-releases/press-release-details/2026/Netflix-to-Announce-Third-Quarter-2026-Financial-Results/default.aspx)); TSLA 10/21 AMC ([SEC](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000162828026064366/exhibit991111111.htm)); IBM 10/21 AMC ([IBM](https://newsroom.ibm.com/2026-10-07-ibm-to-announce-third-quarter-2026-financial-results)).

## Ideas (long-only, swing)
- **WMT**, swing: DB upgrade; inflation share-gainer in defensive tape. Conf: med. Risk: gap fade; hot data hits multiples.
- **UNH**, swing: raised 2026 outlook after Q3 beat ([Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/us-stock-market-today-p-081203137.html)); holding gains pre. Conf: med. Risk: MA/policy headlines.
- **XLV**, swing: rotation continuing (~+1.3% pre, box yfinance). Conf: low. Risk: broad de-risking drags all sectors.

**Avoid:** AI optics (still falling) + CRWV/ORCL (AI debt); airlines (Brent >$100); BAC (AML overhang).
